author: RBMacias50

title: A special city tour through Seville – absolutely recommended!
text:
We discovered Seville during a four-hour private city tour with Carlos and had a really great time!

Since we were traveling as a family with two children (5 and 7 years old), we consciously decided on a private tour – and it was exactly the right choice.

Carlos brought the city, its history, culture, and people closer to us with a lot of knowledge, enthusiasm, and interesting stories. On our walk together, we got to know many beautiful sides of Seville: the cathedral with the Giralda, the Real Alcázar, the beautiful Santa Cruz neighborhood, the Setas de Sevilla, the bullring, and much more.

title: Amigo Carlos. Gracias!
text: We were able to spend a wonderful morning with our city guide, Carlos. His information beforehand was clear, the pickup point was distinct, and Carlos was already waiting for us. What distinguishes Carlos is an incredibly charming manner, cheerfulness, expertise, and good intuition. We can recommend the tour with him at any time.

title: Private walking tour of Seville with Carlos - excellent!
text: We enjoyed the walking tour with Carlos - our experienced local guide, who knows all of the history of each of the neighborhoods in Seville. He is very witty and offered local insights of his historic city. You’ll have plenty of opportunity to get lots of pictures and learn a lot!
